bottom_line: Arrest warrant in Nord Stream sabotage case raises attribution questions with implications for EU-Russia energy relations and infrastructure security.
what_changed: German federal prosecutor issued arrest warrant for a suspect in the Nord Stream pipeline sabotage; suspect linked to Ukrainian military.
why_it_matters: Attribution outcome affects EU-Ukraine relations, subsea infrastructure security investment, and European energy security strategy.
main_uncertainty: Single suspect does not establish state authorization; investigation ongoing across multiple jurisdictions.

scenarios.name: Limited attribution
scenarios.description: Investigation concludes with individual responsibility; no state-level consequences.

scenarios.name: Escalation
scenarios.description: Evidence links operation to state command; diplomatic fallout.
